items.roster: A Working Shift assigned to one person or a whole scope for a date range; the month grid is employee × day, and the newest row covering a day wins.
items.zkteco-devices: The ZKTeco rows of the device register, the push URL each must point at, the last punch heard per serial, and the device-side steps from config/zkteco.json.
items.assets: The asset register: unique code, category, make/model, serial, cost to the paisa, holder, condition, status.
items.asset-issue: Issue, return, repair or retire an asset along config/assets.json's transitions, stamped with who and when; filtered to a person it is the clearance list.
items.calc-logic: How a payslip is computed, step by step, every number read from the live configuration and naming the file or row it came from.
